title: Independent-universe Cech double-complex comparison
statement: For a site C with finite wide pullbacks and sheafification of abelian presheaves, an abelian sheaf F and a covering family indexed in universe w, assuming HasExt in universe w, there is a double complex of AddCommGrpCat in universe w whose column homology is the Cech complex of the cohomology presheaves of F and whose total homology is the sheaf cohomology of F.

source.place: Steps 1--2: universe-lifted injective-resolution double complex and its column and total comparisons

proof.text: OPEN: construct one universe-lifted injective-resolution Cech bicomplex, retaining its resolution and augmentation data. Do not use the split zero-vertical-differential bicomplex supplied by the column-existence theorem. Resolution existence under the stated large-site hypotheses remains disputed.
For that same resolution bicomplex, prove the column comparisons by evaluation of the resolution and compatible universe transports.

For that same resolution bicomplex, prove the total comparison using Cech acyclicity of injectives and its augmentation, with compatible universe transports. Combine both comparisons with the constructed object. This entire joint construction is restored as the existing named Lean obligation.

lean.statement: theorem Sheaf.exists_cechDoubleComplex_general [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})] (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (X : C) {ι : Type w} {U : ι → C} (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) : ∃ D : HomologicalComplex₂ AddCommGrpCat.{w} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ), (∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty (((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D ≅ (cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ Over.mk (π i)).obj ((Over.forget X).op ⋙ F.cohomologyPresheaf q))) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty ((D.total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n ≅ F.H' n X)
